facts.claim: NVIDIA independently identifies Infleqtion among QPU makers and labs already using CUDA-Q Logical, corroborating Infleqtion's participation in fault-tolerant quantum software workflows without relying on Infleqtion-originated material.
NVIDIA independently identifies Infleqtion as an adopter of Ising Calibration and a deployer of Ising Decoding, corroborating active work on quantum calibration and error-correction tooling.

risks: Partner ecosystem adoption corroborates technical engagement but does not establish Infleqtion revenue, margins, customer economics, or achievement of its targeted logical-qubit milestones.

NVIDIA is a commercial ecosystem partner rather than a neutral auditor; these origins are independent of Infleqtion issuer/SEC origins but should not be treated as independent verification of every Infleqtion performance claim.
unknowns: Economic contribution from CUDA-Q/Ising adoption to Infleqtion remains unknown.
Independent measurement of Infleqtion's targeted 30-logical-qubit milestone remains open.
valueAdded: Adds two materially independent NVIDIA-origin primary sources to a packet whose existing five unique origins were all Infleqtion issuer or SEC origins; gives Alpha reusable source-addressed corroboration while preserving underwriting authority.
